nothing-staged.note: A commit was asked for while the index holds no change. Shown after a failed commit in the changes panel and by the changes commit command.

empty-commit-message.remedy: Write a message, then commit again.
empty-commit-message.note: A commit was asked for with a message that is empty or only spaces. Shown after a failed commit in the changes panel and by the changes commit command.

commit-refused.note: git ran the commit and refused it: a hook failed, the signer failed, or the identity is not set. The detail git is the one line of git's output that says why; the whole output is in the error chain and the daemon log.

run-holds-lock.cause: a run is working in this repo
run-holds-lock.remedy: Wait for it to finish, or stop it, then try again.
run-holds-lock.note: A change to the working tree was asked for while a live run holds the repo's lock.
